cause: The checker incorrectly required every applied event to remain the final current review. Two real #134 rejects are subsequently applied by #135; both complete #134 review objects remain in review_history.
factual_correction: 177 applied events cover 175 unique IDs. #134 has 13 current reviews and 2 preserved historical reviews; current review for those 2 is #135.
resolution: Keep this failed stage immutable; post-review-v2 verifies both current and preserved-history events and checks final current review against the last application.
